title: v1 forward test: live fit on 2026-27 games, summable look schedule
hypothesis: The live fit with xg_form and rest, fit through 2025-26, scores below Elo on 2026-27 regular season games. This record replaces 0001-v1-forward-test, which is withdrawn before any result because the look schedule changed from harmonic to summable (#200).
promotion_criterion: 97.5th percentile of block_bootstrap_mean_ci (16-game blocks) of the paired difference, candidate minus Elo, must be below zero (look 1 of the schedule BASE_TAIL / (k * (k + 1)): a tail of 0.025)
